text: The numbers in this video cover Barcelona's opening seven competitive matches, through the Racing game. They describe a remarkable start, not a finished season. That distinction makes the warning more convincing. We do not need to pretend the defence is flawless. We do not need to declare the Champions League over in September. Barcelona have already given us enough to take seriously: Lamine turning invention into goals, Raphinha attacking the spaces, midfielders connecting the moves, and additional forwards changing what the defence has to solve. The next step is making their control match their firepower. If they do that, the conversation gets very interesting. So when Europe looks at these scorelines, the question should go beyond how many Barcelona scored. Ask how many different problems they created. Then ask which one you would try to stop first. Because while you are deciding, the next runner is already moving.
